bat.name: Baseball bat
bat.description: Aluminium, dented. Somebody's Little League bat.

use.text: Cold beans. You eat them anyway.

water.name: Bottled water
water.description: A litre of water. Worth more every hour.

use.text: You drink. Your hands stop shaking, a little.

medicine.name: Painkillers
medicine.description: Spilled from the store shelf. Nobody's paying tonight.

use.text: Two pills, dry. The edge comes off.

bread.name: Bread
bread.description: The one Mom likes, with the seeds.

use.text: You tear off a piece. It tastes like home.

battery_9v.name: 9-volt battery
battery_9v.description: For the smoke alarm in the hall.

use.text: For the smoke alarm. It's been chirping for a week.

mom_card.name: Mom's card
mom_card.description: Her bank card, worn at the corners.

use.text: You have pride. Take the card.

tote_bag.name: Tote bag
tote_bag.description: Canvas. It says 'READ.' Of course it does.

house_key.name: House keys
house_key.description: Mom's spare set on a faded keyring.

box_cutter.name: Box cutter
box_cutter.description: Wade dropped it. Sharp enough for a seatbelt.

use.text: Calling MOM... Call failed. Network busy.

bible.name: Mom's Bible
bible.description: Soft leather, cracked at the spine. Red ink and sticky notes.

letter.name: Mom's letter
letter.description: 'Read this if I'm ever suddenly gone.'
